ce9173b9-519b-42bc-84bd-915d96bd026b#06b.3:
Enlarged Charging Handle "Skeleton". 

 

The AK Extended Charging Handle “Skeleton” is compatible with all AK variants and is designed to ensure fast, comfortable, and safe weapon manipulation in any conditions. Thanks to its increased surface area and improved ergonomics, the hand does not slip even when wearing gloves or in wet environments, providing better control during charging and reloading the weapon.

The charging handle installs on the factory bolt carrier handle and is secured with a silicone bushing and two set screws — this system ensures a solid fit with no risk of slipping at a critical moment.

 

KEY ADVANTAGES:

  • Enhanced grip — comfortable operation even with thick winter gloves.

  • Anti-slip shape — stability and control in dynamic conditions.

  • Secure attachment — a silicone bushing and two set screws hold the charging handle extension firmly in place.

  • Minimal weight — only 14 g, with no impact on the weapon’s balance.

  • High-strength material — aircraft-grade aluminum resistant to heavy loads.

  • Durable finishes — anodizing or Cerakote, depending on your preference.

 

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Step 1. Preparation for Installation

Remove the mounting screws from the enlarged charging handle.

Insert the silicone bushing into the internal cavity of the handle.

 

Step 2. Installation on the Weapon

Slide the enlarged charging handle onto the factory bolt carrier handle until fully seated, with the longer screw on top and the shorter one at the bottom.

Start threading the fixing screws and tighten them evenly.

 

Step 3. Installation Check

Pull the bolt carrier to the rear and ensure the charging handle is securely fixed with no play.

If there is any play or misalignment, loosen the screws, align the handle properly, and retighten them.

DO NOT REMOVE THE PLASTIC INSERT(tube)!

INSTALLATION Video.

add5817e-738f-0ab4-23fc-7ffd06cae018#54c.3:
The “Monolith” M-LOK modular foregrip is designed for installation on civilian and service firearms equipped with the M-LOK interface. Provides enhanced weapon control during firing, allows use as either a vertical foregrip or a hand stop, and improves stability, manipulation speed, and shot-to-shot consistency in dynamic and tactical environments.

DESIGN AND FEATURES:

●       The monolithic body construction provides high rigidity, strength, and complete elimination of play during intensive use.

●       A protrusion shaped as an M-LOK nut is located on the upper part of the body, ensuring correct indexing and stable positioning of the grip on the firearm.

●       Manufactured from aluminum using CNC machining, ensuring precise geometry and long-term durability.

●       The ergonomic shape allows the product to be used either as a full-size vertical foregrip or as a hand stop.

●       Compact dimensions and streamlined profile minimize snagging on gear and surrounding objects.

●       The design is optimized for stable performance under active tactical use.

FUNCTIONAL ADVANTAGES:

●       Improves weapon control during firing and maneuvering.

●       Universal application: functions as a vertical foregrip or low-profile hand stop depending on grip technique and shooting style.

●       Provides stable mounting on the M-LOK interface with no shifting or play.

●       Enhances weapon handling comfort in various shooting positions.

●       Reduces hand fatigue during prolonged use and dynamic operation.

FINISH:

●       Anodizing

●       Cerakote.

Both finish options provide effective protection against corrosion, mechanical wear, and environmental exposure.

COMPATIBILITY AND INSTALLATION:

●       Designed for installation on handguards and components equipped with the M-LOK interface.

●       Installation is performed using standard M-LOK mounting slots.

●       The M-LOK nut-style protrusion ensures correct positioning and stable fixation.

●       Installs as a true drop-in component with no weapon modification or fitting required.

The M-LOK Hand Stop is designed to improve ergonomics and weapon control during shooting. It mounts to the handguard of any carbine with an M-LOK interface and serves as a standalone upgrade component.

 

Provides:

  • a stable grip on the weapon

  • better control when shooting from a rest, standing, or on the move

  • reduced strain on the wrist

  • comfortable operation in tactical conditions

 

KEY ADVANTAGES:

  • Monolithic CNC-milled aluminum body — maximum strength, low weight, and long-term durability.

  • Ergonomic shape — comfortable in the hand, providing a stable grip with gloves and in all conditions.

  • Compatible with all M-LOK handguards — quick installation with no modifications required.

  • Rigid mounting thanks to two M5 screws and M-LOK T-nuts.

  • Durable coating (Anodizing or Cerakote) provides protection against scratches and corrosion.

  • Improves weapon control when shooting standing, kneeling, or on the move.

  • Compatible with various platforms — AR-10, AR-15, AK-based carbines, and more.

 

FEATURES:

  • Machined from a solid block of aluminum with no welded or joined components.

  • Securely mounts to any standard M-LOK interface.

  • Optimized geometry for natural hand placement.

  • Lightweight (110 g), maintaining the weapon’s proper balance.

  • Professional-grade coatings ensure long service life even in field conditions.

 

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

STEP 1 — Preparation

1. Choose the desired position on the handguard with standard M-LOK slots.

2. Ensure the handguard surface is clean and free of damage.

STEP 2 — Installing the hand stop

1. Insert the T-nuts into the M-LOK slots.

2. Position the hand stop on the handguard, aligning the holes with the nuts.

3. Insert the two M5 screws and tighten them until slight resistance is felt.

4. Ensure the nuts have rotated perpendicular to the slot, securing the mount.

5. Fully tighten the screws.

 

STEP 3 — Inspection.

1. Check for the absence of any play.

2. Assess the comfort of the stop’s position within your grip.

3. If necessary, move it to another M-LOK slot.

AK/AKM Folding Buttstock. "AXE"  by GPN.Cerakoted.

 

The folding stock "AXE" is designed to replace the standard stock on various firearm platforms using a dedicated mounting adapter.

 

The design ensures comfortable weapon handling and allows individual adjustment to match the shooter’s ergonomics. It features adjustable buttpad height and a multi-position cheek rest.

The stock folds to the left and securely locks in both folded and deployed positions. The adapter includes separate buttons for folding and unfolding.

The rubberized buttpad features vertical adjustment with up to 13 mm travel, allowing precise shoulder positioning.

  • Adjustable cheek rest with rubberized surface
    Cheek rest length — 127 mm

  • Sling socket on the adapter axis for quick sling attachment

  • QD sling socket at the rear near the buttpad

  • Finish — Cerakote.

 

FEATURES:

  • 7075 aluminum using high-precision CNC machining

  • Set screws on the hinge eliminate play during operation

  • Buttpad with vertical adjustment (13 mm travel)

  • Adjustable cheek rest (height and angle)

  • Folding mechanism with rigid lock in both positions

  • With an adapter of your choice.

 

Installs on:

7075 aluminum provides high structural strength with low weight.

bc61257f-c613-596d-7507-59aa7026a5d1#37f.3:
AK-47/AKM 7.62x39mm Flash Hider. By GPN. Cerakoted. 3-piece design.

 

The 7.62x39mm modular flash hider is designed to effectively reduce visible muzzle flash during firing and decrease the shooter’s visual signature.

Specialized design ensures uniform gas dispersion, significantly reducing flash intensity and duration while improving control and comfort in low-light conditions

Designed for firearms chambered in 7.62x39mm with M14×1 LH muzzle thread.

Installs on factory muzzle thread without additional adapters.

 

DESIGN AND FEATURES:

  • Serviceable construction (outer body + internal module + locking nut)

  • Fully disassemblable for carbon cleaning

  • Internal gas distribution element optimizes propellant gas flow

  • Extended internal channel for improved flow stabilization

  • Reinforced front section

  • Precision bore alignment with barrel axis

  • External knurling on locking nut for easier installation

Maintains consistent performance under intensive fire and allows inspection of internal components during maintenance.

 

MATERIAL AND FINISH:

  • Material: High-strength steel

  • Manufacturing: CNC turning and milling

  • Finish:  Cerakote

Steel construction ensures durability and resistance to mechanical stress and high temperatures

Cerakote enhances wear resistance, corrosion protection, and durability in harsh operating conditions.

 

COMPATIBILITY AND INSTALLATION:

  • Compatibility: AK, AKM, AKS, AKSU, and other 7.62x39mm caliber platforms.

  • Thread: M14×1 LH

  • Mounting type: Thread-on installation

 

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Ensure firearm is unloaded before installation

Thread flash hider onto factory muzzle thread until fully seated
Verify proper bore alignment with barrel axis
Check secure attachment and absence of play

Recheck tightness after initial firing.

 

Package Contents:

  • Serviceable flash hider 7.62x39 (outer body)

  • Internal module

  • Locking nut

 

WARNING!

  • Use only with barrels featuring M14×1 LH thread.

  • Inspect thread condition and bore alignment before installation

  • Clean internal module regularly to prevent carbon buildup

If unsure about installation, consult a qualified specialist.

2601d144-d526-58cb-d997-8e32fbfb1892#2b0.2: Extended Charging Handle "Helix". AK/AKM by GPN. Anodized
2601d144-d526-58cb-d997-8e32fbfb1892#2b0.3:
Enlarged Charging Handle "Helix".

 

The AK Extended Charging Handle “Helix” (Tromix) is compatible with all AK variants and is designed to ensure fast, comfortable, and safe weapon manipulation in any conditions. Thanks to its increased surface area and improved ergonomics, the hand does not slip even when wearing gloves or in wet environments, providing better control during charging and reloading the weapon.

The charging handle installs on the factory bolt carrier handle and is secured with a silicone bushing and two set screws — this system ensures a solid fit with no risk of slipping at a critical moment.

KEY ADVANTAGES

  • Enhanced grip — comfortable operation even with thick winter gloves.

  • Anti-slip shape — stability and control in dynamic conditions.

  • Secure attachment — a silicone bushing and two set screws hold the charging handle extension firmly in place.

  • Minimal weight — only 14 g, with no impact on the weapon’s balance.

  • High-strength material — aircraft-grade aluminum resistant to heavy loads.

  • Durable finishes — anodizing or Cerakote, depending on your preference.

  •  

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Step 1. Preparation for Installation.

Remove the mounting screws from the enlarged charging handle.

Insert the silicone bushing into the internal cavity of the handle.

 

Step 2. Installation on the Weapon.

Slide the enlarged charging handle onto the factory bolt carrier handle until fully seated, with the longer screw on top and the shorter one at the bottom.

Start threading the fixing screws and tighten them evenly.

 

Step 3. Installation Check.

Pull the bolt carrier to the rear and ensure the charging handle is securely fixed with no play.

If there is any play or misalignment, loosen the screws, align the handle properly, and retighten them.

Slide the enlarged charging handle onto the factory bolt carrier handle until fully seated, with the longer screw on top and the shorter one at the bottom.

Start threading the fixing screws and tighten them evenly.

Pull the bolt carrier to the rear and ensure the charging handle is securely fixed with no play.

If there is any play or misalignment, loosen the screws, align the handle properly, and retighten them.

Bipod is designed to increase the stability of weapons during shooting, reduce vibrations and improve accuracy.

On the side surfaces of the base there are grooves for fixing the legs in 5 different positions.

The bipods are installed in three positions at different angles of inclination (45, 90, and 135 degrees).

To change the position of the legs, you need to pull the leg down, turn it to the desired position and release it - the fixation occurs automatically.

The leg length is fixed with a button - when pressed, the leg can change its length.

The legs have telescopic height adjustment (4 positions).

The leg length adjustment range is 45 mm.

The leg length is fixed with a button - when pressed, the leg can change its length.

To quickly increase the length of the legs, simply pull it down.

A separate button is provided for folding the legs on each of them.

The foot of the leg is equipped with two steel cones for reliable fixation in the ground or on hard surfaces

 

Mounting and functionality

 

The bipods are equipped with a quick-release mount, which allows you to quickly remove them from the weapon.

To prevent accidental detachment, a locking handle (twist) is provided.

A Picatinny rail is included in the kit, designed for installing a quick-release mount on the weapon.

Can be installed both under the fore-end (bottom) and above the fore-end (top), which expands the options for use.

To change the position of the legs, you need to pull the leg down, turn it to the desired position and release it - the fixation occurs automatically.

Overall dimensions when unfolded, mm - 225x320x114

Tango Tactical. Handcrafted Custom Made Rigs, Pouches, Belts etc.

DENIM / CORDURA 1000D LAMINATE CHEST RIG

Built for fun, made for anything.

This chest rig blends everyday denim with technical reinforcement materials to create something that feels casual in appearance, but performs far beyond it when needed.

It’s designed for people who don’t want their gear to look overly tactical, but still want something that can handle real use without hesitation.

 

Materials

The outer layer is durable high-density denim — familiar, comfortable, and visually low-key.

Inside, it’s backed by Cordura 1000D laminate, giving the structure strength, stability, and abrasion resistance where it actually matters.

The two layers are bonded into a single unified platform, so it behaves like one solid piece of gear rather than stacked materials.

 

Design Approach

This rig is about balance.

Not military, not fashion — something in between.

It’s meant to disappear into everyday life, but still be ready when things get active, messy, or unpredictable.

You can wear it in the city, on trips, at work, in the field — and it never feels out of place.

 

Features

  • Modular front layout for magazines, tools, or EDC setups

  • Even weight distribution for all-day comfort

  • Reinforced structure in key load areas

  • Low-profile shape that works with casual clothing

  • Flexible configuration depending on your setup and use case

 

Compatibility

All attachment points follow widely used MOLLE / PALS standards, making it compatible with gear from brands like Crye Precision, Warrior Assault Systems, Spiritus Systems, and other common ecosystems.

No lock-in — just use what you already have and build it the way you like.

 

Use Cases

This rig is made for a mix of real-world and recreational use:

  • everyday carry setups and urban use

  • travel, work, and active lifestyle scenarios

  • airsoft and training environments

  • Saturday range days and casual shooting sessions

  • gear experimentation and loadout building for fun

It’s the kind of platform you can throw on without overthinking it — whether you’re going out for a normal day or heading to the range just because it’s Saturday.

 

Core Idea

A chest rig that doesn’t try to look like anything in particular.

Just solid, adaptable gear that works when you need it — and is genuinely fun to run when you don’t.

The Picatinny rail for AKS-74U/AKSU/"Krink" is designed for mounting additional aiming and tactical equipment on AKS-74U platform carbines.
It provides a reliable and rigid mounting base for red dot sights, optics, flashlights, and other accessories, while maintaining the compact profile of the weapon.

Thanks to its modular design and the ability to install additional 45° M-LOK brackets, the user gains flexibility in configuring accessories without overloading the structure.

Suitable for:

  • combat use;

  • training shooting;

  • AKS-74U modernization and tuning;

  • operation in harsh field conditions.

Design and features:

  • Manufactured from aircraft-grade aluminum using CNC milling.

  • Provides rigid fixation with no play or shift during firing.

  • Compact dimensions are optimized for the shortened AKS-74U platform.

  • Weight with additional 45° rails (right and left): 80 g

  • Total kit weight: 84 g

  • Effective Picatinny rail length: 82 mm (8 slots)

  • Includes additional 45° M-LOK brackets (right and left) for mounting accessories (flashlights, laser aiming devices, etc.)

  • Designed for intensive use without loss of geometry

  • Optimal balance of strength and weight.

Package Contents:

  • Main Picatinny rail

  • 45° M-LOK mounting brackets

  • Mounting Hardware

Finish options:

  • Anodizing

  • Cerakote.

Both finish options provide protection against corrosion, mechanical wear, and environmental exposure.

Compatibility and installation:

  • Designed specifically for AKS-74

  • Installs without any weapon modification or fitting

  • Does not obstruct the factory iron sights.

RPK Medium Handguard.

The handguard is designed to replace the standard handguard on RPK-based machine guns (RPK-74). It provides increased rigidity of the front end of the weapon, improved ergonomics, and the ability to mount additional equipment (foregrips, hand stops, flashlights, etc.) without the need for extra adapters, thanks to the M-LOK interface.

Suitable for:

  • combat use;

  • training use;

  • weapon modernization and tuning;

  • operation in harsh field conditions.

Design and features:

  • The handguard consists of a main body and an upper cover (various configurations), which are connected to each other by spacer posts.

  • The body features a one-piece CNC-machined base, a rear mounting interface, and a crescent-shaped front locking element.

  • The adjustable crescent-shaped locking element allows precise fitting of the handguard to a specific weapon without any modifications.

  • The upper cover is CNC-machined from aluminum and provides additional rigidity and protection.

  • The design is intended for intensive use without loss of geometry or the development of play.

  • M-LOK interface for mounting additional accessories.

  • Supplied with Picatinny rail sections: L63 mm — 1 pc, L80 mm — 2 pcs.

  • Handguard weight with one upper cover (solid or with spacer posts): 342 g

  • Handguard weight with two upper covers (solid or with spacer posts): 442 g

  • Handguard weight with one long upper cover: 400 g

  • Weight of the Picatinny rail sections (L63 mm — 1 pc, L80 mm — 2 pcs): 88 g

Finish:

Available finish options:

  • Anodizing

  • Cerakote.

Both finishes provide protection against corrosion, mechanical wear, and environmental exposure.

Compatibility and installation:

  • Installs on standard factory mounting points.

  • Does not require any weapon modification or fitting.

  • Provides a rigid and stable fit without any play.

  • The standard bipod cannot be locked in the folded position.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:

The dust cover «AA 01.03.001» consists of a body made of a solid aluminum bar and a clamping mechanism.

The mechanical clamp includes a metal frame, an adjustment wheel, a guide screw, and an M5 set screw (guzhon). The frame is located inside the rear part of the cover and is attached to it by means of a guide screw with an M5 thread and an M3 set screw, which is screwed into the right side of the cover body and acts as a stopper, preventing it from detaching from the cover. The frame is moved by an adjustment wheel attached to the other side of the guide screw. 

The M5 set screw is screwed in parallel to the guide screw and prevents the adjustment wheel from unscrewing on its own because the ball of the set screw fits into the grooves on the wheel. The front part of the cover is cone-shaped, which provides additional self-locking attachment to the weapon.

Additional options: The Picatinny rail located at the top of the cover allows additional equipment to be attached to it.

NOTE:  Dust cover was made using soviet blueprints. Please confirm with the manufacturer of your rifle if they followed the soviet design. Otherwise it may not fit.

The AA-06.10.000 quick-release mount for optics consists of four elements: a
base, a clamp, a clamping foot, a retaining button, and a dovetail mount.
The base of the mount is a solid milled aluminum element. The upper part of the
base has a Picatinny rail for mounting optical devices and equipment. The design
includes a dovetail mounting slot, adjustment and locking points, and shaped slots to
reduce the weight of the product.
The clamp is made of high-quality steel using milling. It is used to fix the base on
the dovetail. It is connected to the base with an M5 bolt and pressed against the base by
two springs for easy installation. The M5 bolt allows you to adjust the clamping force of

presser foot to the base and prevents it from bending spontaneously with the help of a
tooth. It is connected to the base with an M3 bolt and is pressed against the base by a
spring to hold the foot.
The dovetail is made of a solid milled high-quality steel bar. The body has three
holes into which T-shaped nuts with M5 thread are pressed.

installation and they are installed on the weapon instead of the standard ones.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:

The long barrel with cover “AA-11.00.000” consists of a body, a cover (long or short), a receiver cover, and a rotating mechanism. The body has a solid milled base, rear mounting, crescent, and bridge. The rear mount is connected to the base with three screws with a hidden cap, which have an M4 thread. The crescent is located inside the base and is attached to it with two screws with a hidden cap, which have an M4 thread, and two threaded inserts, which ensure a reliable connection. The crescent is adjustable, which allows the front sight to be installed on any carbine of this type. The bridge is connected to the base at the front with two M4 threaded screws with countersunk heads.

The overlay is made of solid milled aluminum metal. A Picatinny rail is located in its upper part. The overlay is connected to the body using M4 threaded cap screws.

The receiver cover consists of a body made of a solid aluminum bar and a clamping mechanism. The mechanical clamp includes a metal frame, an adjustment wheel, a guide screw, and an M5 set screw . The frame is located inside the rear part of the cover and is attached to it by means of a guide screw with an M5 thread and an M3 set screw, which is screwed into the right side of the cover body and acts as a stopper, preventing it from detaching from the cover. The frame is moved by an adjustment wheel attached to the other side of the guide screw. 

The M5 setting screw is screwed in parallel to the guide screw and prevents the adjustment wheel from unscrewing on its own because the ball of the nut fits into the grooves on the wheel. The front part of the cover is cone-shaped, which provides additional self-locking attachment to the weapon.

The rotating mechanism consists of an adapter bracket, which is attached to the receiver cover with two screws, two mirror plates, which are attached to the overlay (long or short), two bushings, and two screws that hold the mechanism together. There are two grooves in the middle of the adapter bracket in which the springs are located.

1758b125-2be4-45d5-91c6-eda5186f412a#1ec.2: Recoil Buffer for AK based Rifles by "STRELA"
1758b125-2be4-45d5-91c6-eda5186f412a#1ec.3:
Polyurethane recoil buffer for AK is suitable for any weapon based on (AK-74, AKM, FORT-201, Volcano, Saiga-MK, Boar Hammer 12k, Saiga 12k and other AK modifications)

The purpose of the recoil buffer is to take the hit of the bolt carrier. This prevents metal from hitting the metal and makes the recoil a little softer.
It is recommended to use it together with a silencer, as the buffer will remove the excess clang of a bolt carrier.

The AK buffer itself is made of German polyurethane, the best on the market.

Can Take up to 6000 rounds.

Attention AK owners with a folding butt Stock! The polyurethane buffer is made to occupy an entire space in the receiver of the AK (due to this, the buffer is held securely inside and is ready for the most extreme loads). Due to the buttstock lock button, the buffer will need to be trimmed at the bottom step, reducing it in height.

In 2015, "KRYK" team embarked on an ambitious project to create a modern tuning package for more than one hundred years old Mosin-Nagant rifle.

Why did they choose the Mosin?

Because it is one of the hardest for such tuning of rifles and of course - because we can!

The basic tasks was:

Task 1 - to bring ergonomics and ease of use of a century-old rifle to the standards of modern weapons.

Task 2 - to utilize the demount-able magazine.

Task 3 - give an opportunity in the presence of a good barrel for an affordable price to get an accurate rifle.

Product features:

Strong octagonal handguard with additional ribs for ultimate strength

M-LOK ™ interface for mounting various accessories

Compatible with AR type pistol grips

Buttstock is attached to a standard AR-type thread

Using V-shaped bedding technology

Compatibility with third-party triggers

Materials:

  1. Chassis - aluminium alloy 7075 ?651.

  2. Handguard - aluminium alloy 6082 T6.

Production method - milling

In all hard loaded threads, we use special steel inserts that increase the possible tightening power of the screws and increase the life of the thread itself.

We use Cerakote two-component ceramic coating for maximum protection of the surface.

In the all sets of our products screws with a class of strength not lower than 10.9. We don't use low-strength soft materials

In the complete set of CRC 7U001:

  1. Chassis - aluminum alloy 7075 T651.

  2. Handguard - aluminum alloy 6082 T6. Handguard has M-Lok accessories mounts. The kit includes 3 rails length of 80mm.


This chassis accepts ProMag Archangel 5rd Magazine.

The buttstock shown is here.


NOTE: The kit only includes the chassis-handguard and 3 Picatinny rails.

The buttstock, magazine, scope mount and other accessories are purchased separately.

A set of measuring gauges for checking the barrel bore wear of carbines in .223REM/5.56 caliber. The set includes calibers with a diameter of 5.53, 5.54, 5.55, 5.56, 5.57, 5.58, 5.59 and a no-go caliber of 5.60 mm, as well as an adapter-handle and a storage case.

Attention!!! Before any manipulation of the weapon, make sure that the carbine is unloaded.

All calibers in the set are made of a special grade of tool steel. Their cylindrical part is made with high precision, has a given diameter and processed to the required hardness, which allows them to be used to measure the bore without fear of its safety.

This set of .223REM/5.56 calibers allows for an objective assessment of the diameter from the rifled barrel bore fields. This set provides verification of the bore diameter in the range 5.53 ... 5.60, with an accuracy of 0.01mm. Each of the calibers has its own strictly defined diameter with a positive tolerance. Adjacent calibers in the set differ from each other in diameter by one strictly specified value. The number of calibers in the set is selected in such a way that together they cover the specified range of measurements of the barrel bore in the fields. This allows you to check and reject the barrels of such weapons with the required accuracy in the entire range of current sizes.

Attention! It should be remembered that the cleaner the inner surface of the barrel, the more accurate the result obtained and the longer the service life of the caliber set.

d213a462-db5d-4dfa-8f8b-3bbf8110f10a#513.2: Top cover with Picatinny rail for Saiga/AK-47/AK-74/AKM.
d213a462-db5d-4dfa-8f8b-3bbf8110f10a#513.3:
Quick detached Top cover with a Picatinny rail to install the collimator and optical sights on the Saiga, AK hunting carbines.

The upgraded cover allows you to leave the native mechanical parts.

The main advantages of this product are ergonomics, durability, and low weight. The weight of the top cover is 160 grams only. Picatinny rail located directly on the top cover and it allows users to install their collimators and other sights on their Saiga and AK based rifles at a comfortable distance from the eye.

The top cover is entirely milled from a single blank of aviation 2024T aluminum alloy, which ensures manufacturing accuracy, strength

and the low weight of the product.

The cover is installed in the same way as the native cover of the receiver, except for the fact that there is an original design

for fixing the spring return button in the back.

As a result, there is no backlash and the point of aim does not change when removing and installing the cover.

bf80e8af-d937-42e4-83da-10de8384a90f#ec3.2: AR-10 Muzzle Brake "Tornado" by ME. Thread 5/8x24. Cal .308/7.62

AK Muzzle brake “Tornado” was specially designed for AR-10 in .308Win with 5/8x24 thread. Very unique design reduces recoil and completely eliminates muzzle rise during firing of the weapon.

This muzzle brake compensator effectively cleans the barrel toss when firing and reduces recoil momentum of the shot thanks to a unique system of exhaust propellant gases.

Muzzle brake is widely used in hunting as one of the feature is that it removes the sound of the shot in the back and side of the shooter, without revealing the location of the shooter.

Muzzle brake compensator Tornado will allow you to effectively conduct a quick and aimed fire.

Caliber: .308Win

Lenth: 71 mm

Diameter: 25.8 mm

Weight: 150 gr.

Thread: 5/8x24
